definition: בֹּ֫הוּ noun [masculine] emptiness (on form see Ges «GKC:84a»§ 84a , 1 b Sta § 95, 198 a, on usage compare Lag Or. ii. 60 f. ) always with תֹּהוּ q. v.; — תֹּהוּ וָבֹהוּ Gen 1:2 of primeval earth; Jer 4:23 of earth under judgment of ׳ י ; קַותֿֿהֹוּ וְאַבְנֵי בֹהוּ Isa 34:11 , the line of wasteness and the stones of emptiness , i.e. plummets, employed, not as usual for building, but for destroying walls; compare Di & see below אבן 6.
